context_requirements: Functional HCAR3 receptor expression; HCAR3 is primarily expressed in adipocytes and immune cells and is not a canonical transcriptional regulator in the assayed epithelial, melanoma, hepatic, colorectal, breast, prostate, or lung lines.
G-protein coupling competent to produce a measurable transcriptional response within 6-24 h; no such response is expected in these lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and consistent with HCAR3 activation.
Evidence of HCAR3-dependent signaling or target-gene induction in these cell lines.
